name: husrevity
description: Husrevity monorepo — NestJS API + Next.js web, Bun workspaces

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.build: bun run build:api && bun run build:web
scripts.db:backup: APP_NAME=husrevity-dev PG_CONTAINER=shared-postgres PG_DB=husrevity_nest PG_USER=postgres BACKUP_DIR=$HOME/Backup/husrevity-db-dumps BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS=14 bash $HOME/iamhusrev-prod/scripts/pg-backup.sh
